{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABdEL2wg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhGme5Q", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 239, "title": "Preload executable graph AI models when Live opens; gate Start until ready", "body": "## Goal

Make model preparation and Live readiness predictable:

1. **Graph Editor → Save:** download, verify and retain all required model asset files in browser-local Cache Storage (as currently intended); no inference/GPU initialization at Save.
2. **Open Live:** immediately determine the **saved graph's executable paths** and load/initialize all AI model instances needed by those paths into memory / GPU **before recording begins**.
3. **While preparing:** show a concise **"Preparing models…"** state/progress in Live and **disable Start**.
4. **When all required models are ready:** show **"Ready"**, enable Start (subject to existing input/tab/permission constraints), and let Start begin the session without another heavy model load.
5. **During the session:** reuse these already-initialized model instances, including translation, summary, condition, TTS and ASR. No surprise model loading on the first incoming text, trigger, button action, or audio.
6. **Close Live:** tear down owned Workers, model instances, GPU resources and other preloaded state. Cached model files persist. Handle Stop/Cancel cleanly without leaks; when Live remains open and goes back to idle, ensure models are ready (reuse safely or restore readiness before re-enabling Start).

The user accepts waiting when opening Live in exchange for a predictable and responsive Start/recording experience.

## Current behavior / why change

- `extension/graph-page.js` saves the graph and calls `GraphModelPreparation.replace(saved)`. `extension/graph-model-preparation.js` prepares model **files**, including model-bearing parked nodes.
- `extension/session.js` loads ASR and starts the Pipeline after explicit Start; `extension/graph-runtime.js` initializes active processors at Pipeline start.
- `web/text-summary-node.js` currently has a special `lazy` mode for a path with triggered Hold, causing first-use model initialization. This should not delay the first summary in Live anymore.
- File cache readiness (downloaded and verified) is not equivalent to model runtime/Worker/GPU readiness.

Aim for a clear **Saved asset preparation → Live model initialization → Start actual capture/processing** lifecycle. Do not merely move status text while keeping initialization deferred to first use.

## Runtime scope and lifecycle requirements

- Select **only model instances on executable routes to output sinks**, using existing `executableGraph(savedGraph)` logic (not every parked/unconnected Node). This intentionally differs from Save-time asset preparation, which may include parked Nodes.
- Preload **every required executable model** on Live opening, whether or not its input has produced data and whether or not it sits behind a Button/Hold gate. Remove/bypass first-input-only model loading in Live (without losing the ability to use Hold/trigger for execution).
- Separate **initializing inference resources** from **starting a processing session**. Preloading must not invoke audio capture, microphone permissions, speaker activation, tab capture, user-visible output, trigger events, synthetic graph inputs, or actual inference. Keep permissions tied to the explicit Start gesture.
- Preserve connected startup-configuration semantics: e.g. Whisper language and ReazonSpeech maxDuration are supplied by graph constants/inputs and must be applied correctly **before** effective model initialization. Avoid taking incorrect defaults, racing real initialization, or running a duplicate startup pass.
- Ensure Start uses the **same ready model/Worker resources**, not a second allocation/reload. For multiple instances of the same model, retain correct per-Node processing/state isolation and avoid unintentional resource duplication where safe sharing is possible.
- Do not let opening Graph Editor/Models trigger GPU loading. The preparation belongs to Live's lifetime.
- Keep installed/browser-bundled model assets functioning without downloads. Never initiate new model downloads on Live/Start: missing/evicted/corrupt assets must produce an actionable error with preparation/recovery instructions.
- React to saved graph changes **while Live is open**: stop/reject stale initialization, release obsolete resources, and prepare the new saved graph before allowing the next Start. An already running session must continue using its immutable active graph and not be hot-swapped.
- Coordinate concurrent prepares/Starts, window close, Stop/Cancel, aborted preloading, GPU loss, model failures, and retry; no leaked Workers/VRAM or stale Ready status. Document a simple, testable model lifecycle state machine.
- If the executable graph has no AI models, Live should become ready immediately after ordinary graph validation.
- If required models cannot all be initialized (including memory limits/WebGPU unsupported), show per-model actionable errors and keep Start unavailable rather than pretending the graph is ready. Allow retry/recovery without hiding the issue. Keep operational status compact: a preparation/ready indicator is explicitly requested; preserve the existing Live error-first philosophy (#227).
- Loading progress may be per Node/model or an aggregate with simple steps; don't invent percentage progress if the runtime cannot report it.

## UI expected behavior

```text
Graph Save:   saved graph + model files verified/downloaded (no GPU load)
Live opened:  "Preparing models…" [Start disabled]
Live ready:   "Ready"              [Start enabled]
Start:        permissions/capture and pipeline processing begin with warm models
Stop/Cancel:  session ends; Live maintains/reestablishes readiness for next Start
Live closed:  workers and memory/GPU resources released; file cache remains
```

Show a clear actionable error if any required file is unavailable, with links/steps to Graph Save / Models recovery. Do not request microphone/audio or screen/tab capture permissions until explicit Start. Respect the existing compact Live layout.

## Likely touch points

- `extension/recorder.js`, Live initialization / Start enablement and UI rendering.
- `extension/session.js`, session lifecycle and preflight/ready state.
- `extension/graph-runtime.js`, constructing/initializing model Nodes independent of pipeline Start.
- `extension/graph-model-preparation.js` and model caches (preserve existing Save-time file preparation, avoid GPU initialization there).
- `web/text-summary-node.js`, ASR startup configuration, translation scheduler, IfCondition, TTS model ownership as required.
- Existing automated browser/extension tests and relevant docs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Saving a graph prepares and verifies **model files** without loading inference models into GPU memory; opening/Load/Import without Save does not download.
- [ ] Opening Live with a saved executable AI graph starts initialization **before Start** and visibly reports **Preparing models…**, with Start disabled.
- [ ] When all required active graph model instances are truly initialized, Live reports Ready and Start is enabled (subject to established permissions/navigation constraints).
- [ ] Start doesn't load models anew, and no model allocation/loading is triggered by first incoming text/audio, Hold-triggered action, or TTS text; first-use action goes directly to actual inference using ready resources.
- [ ] Parked/non-executable Node models do not consume RAM/VRAM in Live. No-model graph reaches Ready promptly.
- [ ] Existing ASR `language` / `maxDuration` inputs and any required graph startup configuration still take effect; no audio/permissions/output side effects occur before Start.
- [ ] Restart/Stop/Cancel, Live window close, and saved graph changes do not leak Workers or GPU memory, duplicate initialization, process stale graph state, or allow Start with unready resources.
- [ ] Missing assets, initialization failure, insufficient RAM/VRAM, GPU loss and retry result in correct disabled/ready states, actionable errors and recovery paths; no network downloads during Live.
- [ ] Tests verify a hand-triggered summary is already loaded before first button press, a multi-model graph, ASR+translation graph, parked model, no-model graph, graph change mid-preparation, and repeated start/stop/close; update developer/user docs.

No graph JSON/schema/Node port changes, and no redesign of graph execution or output semantics beyond moving model resource initialization into the Live open/preflight lifecycle.", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/239", "created_at": "2026-11-06T15:30:01Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/my-audio-to-text", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "bc226930b87e4cab93782f37734ead25"}
